-  def cat(Vec(NClause), Vec(NClause)) Vec(NClause)

+  # reverse a list onto an accumulator (pure Rian, cons recursion) — generic in the

+  def rev(xs Vec(T), acc Vec(T)) Vec(T) forall T

   def rev([x | xs], acc) := rev(xs, [x | acc])
